physicalNotes: Radius 1.65 Jupiter radii from Schulte et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168...32S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...32S/abstract): 117,961.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
